requirement.text: All network transactions that involve financial information or personally identifiable information shall be encrypted.

initial_eus.title: Encryption of Financial and Personal Data in Transit
initial_eus.description: As a user, I want all network transactions involving my financial information or personally identifiable information to be encrypted, so that this information is protected from unauthorized access during transmission.
work_items: All network transactions that involve financial information shall be encrypted.
All network transactions that involve personally identifiable information shall be encrypted.

analysis.ethical_objective: Protect the confidentiality of financial and personally identifiable information during network transmission.

obligations.text: Network transactions involving financial information shall be encrypted.
obligations.source_span: All network transactions that involve financial information or personally identifiable information shall be encrypted.

obligations.text: Network transactions involving personally identifiable information shall be encrypted.
obligations.source_span: All network transactions that involve financial information or personally identifiable information shall be encrypted.

constraints: Applies to all network transactions, without exception, that involve financial information or personally identifiable information.
Applies only to network transactions; the source does not address data at rest or other processing contexts.
ambiguities: The source does not define what constitutes financial information or personally identifiable information.
The source does not define the scope of a 'network transaction' (e.g., internal vs. external communications).
The source does not specify encryption strength, algorithms, protocols, or key management requirements.
The source does not specify whether the entire transaction or only the sensitive data elements must be encrypted.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume a specific encryption standard, algorithm, or protocol (e.g., TLS version, AES key size).
Do not assume requirements for encryption of data at rest or in storage.
Do not assume specific legal or regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, PCI DSS) define the covered information.
Do not assume requirements for key management, certificate handling, or auditing of encryption.
Do not assume that transactions without such information must also be encrypted.
Do not assume a mechanism for classifying or detecting sensitive information as a separate requirement.
possible_operational_aspects: Applicability is conditional on a network transaction involving financial information or personally identifiable information.
The obligation is universal within its scope ('all' such transactions).

work_items.explanation: The work item restates the requirement that all network transactions involving financial information be encrypted, directly expressing O1 and preserving the universal scope ('all').
The work item restates the requirement that all network transactions involving personally identifiable information be encrypted, directly expressing O2 and preserving the universal scope ('all').
